figurative_meaning_en: parts of the body or limbs
similar_in_english: the nuts and bolts (of the body)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বয়স বাড়ার সাথে সাথে তার শরীরের কলকব্জা দুর্বল হয়ে পড়েছে।
এই দুর্ঘটনায় তার কলকব্জা আঘাত পেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: As he aged, the parts of his body became weak.
In the accident, his limbs were injured.
note: Refers to the mechanical analogy of the human body in Bengali folk expressions.
